subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub support shareable cron-job templates as a first-class catalog surface, and if so which artifact and trust model should own them?
rationale: Current main has adjacent skill/plugin catalog primitives but no approved cron-template package model or install security boundary, so automation cannot safely choose the product direction.

options.title: Design First-Class Cron Templates
options.body: Define a new template/package model with explicit preview, consent, moderation, install authority, and OpenClaw runtime compatibility before implementation.

options.title: Use Existing Skills Or Bundles
options.body: Treat scheduled workflows as skills or bundle plugins and document a convention without adding a new package family.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Leave cron template sharing out of ClawHub until OpenClaw's scheduled-job runtime contract is clearer.

recommendation.title: Design First-Class Cron Templates
recommendation.body: Define a new template/package model with explicit preview, consent, moderation, install authority, and OpenClaw runtime compatibility before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is tied to the current package family schema, package docs, and catalog state that would need product-direction changes.
